name: knotless
description: A staging network's knotless (dev up --with-knotless): a push lands a check from a rented network VM, after: [build] artifacts, per-workflow executor bindings, a pull gets no secrets.

actions.label: Push
actions.description: A workflow pushed to a fresh repo: the runner rents a network bidder's VM, the check lands success.

actions.label: After
actions.description: build keeps an artifact; test (after: [build]) reads it in its VM with $KNOTLESS_ARTIFACTS_URL and $KNOTLESS_ARTIFACTS_TOKEN; knotless run artifacts --out downloads it.

actions.label: Executor
actions.description: Two workflows on two bindings (executor: small, big): each VM has its binding's vCPUs.

actions.label: Pull
actions.description: A sealed secret: the push to main sees it, a pull's run gets none.
